rv.q: At NSMT, however, the show's cheeky story of how we all set out with dreams for our lives sometimes devolves into parody that plays like weak sketch comedy.
Packed with colorful characters doused with a mix of rock raunchiness and self aware humor, Rock of Ages holds a mirror up to the era of excess and distinct self expression.
All you care about with NSMT 's "ROCK OF AGES" is hearing these great tunes executed by a phenomenal cast and orchestra, with some exciting dances all performed in-the-round with great intensity.
By and large, the cast provides the dual-threat skills needed to pull off this rock opera.
